items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: I know the old Octave Gasper and Vic Gasper, Tatone and...

ctx.x: We went out with Professor Mineta, and he gave me his copy. He didn't give it to me. He loaned it to me, and we made a new copy of that. It has Clarence Williams sitting down here on the floor, which you can't see on this one. They cut off Terence Williams on this picture, but the rest of the band is all...
I know the old Octave Gasper and Vic Gasper, Tatone and...
I never got to meet the Gasper.
